maria-ml: FYI nightly-eval alerted on grok_prompt_set — pass rate dropped 94% -> 65% on main-nightly after last runtime rollout. p50 logprob delta +1.8 and token-level entropy spike. Suspect the most recent prefetch reorder change in runtime (PR #4821).
kevin-runtime: saw the alert in dashboards. That PR reordered KV prefetch looping to reduce stalls. I didn't expect it to affect sampling randomness but ok, starting debug.
sophia-qa: grabbing a few failed gen examples from the nightly run:

sophia-qa: ```
PROMPT: "Summarize the user's intent: I need to migrate my db to a new region."
EXPECTED: concise migration steps
ACTUAL: repeated phrase and sudden cut-off:
"You should create a new database in the new region, create a snapshot, restore the snapshot in the new region. You should create a new database in the new region, create a snapshot, restore the snapshot..."
```
maria-ml: also seeing increased repetition and lower diversity for top-p sampling at temp=0.8 in the failing runs.
kevin-runtime: can you repro locally with the same nightly build? Which model + quant?
sophia-qa: model/generation details from failing job: model=grove-7b-q4f16, sampling kwargs: {"temperature": 0.8, "top_p": 0.92, "seed": null}, runtime build=runtime@9a3b4c7, commit: "prefetch: reorder prefetch loop to improve throughput" (PR #4821).
kevin-runtime: thanks. I'll run deterministic repro with explicit seed. If prefetch reorder touches KV cache timing we could be changing RNG advancement timing (sampler reads RNG between token steps).

maria-ml: eval-bot output snippets:

eval-bot: "nightly-eval grok_prompt_set: baseline 2026-03-14 pass=94.2% -> main-nightly 2026-03-15 pass=64.9%, mean logprob delta +1.82, repeat-rate +22%"

kevin-runtime: quick experiment: running the same input with older runtime build (runtime@7f2e1b2) vs runtime@9a3b4c7. Using seed=42, top_p=0.92, temp=0.8:

kevin-runtime: ```
# repro script
python repro/generate.py --model grove-7b-q4f16 --seed 42 --temp 0.8 --top_p 0.92 --runtime-bin ./bin/runtime@9a3b4c7
```

kevin-runtime: results: older build -> expected diverse answer. new build -> early repetition after 2-3 tokens. RNG stream differs at token N because the order of prefetch causes KV reads/writes to interleave differently with sampling ops.

sophia-qa: so it's non-deterministic unless seeded, but nightly uses non-deterministic runs so that amplifies. Any quick mitigations?
kevin-runtime: two options: revert the prefetch reorder (fast) or enforce strict ordering around RNG-affecting ops (slower patch). I can try a guarded flag PREFETCH_STRICT_ORDER that preserves old ordering for sampling-critical paths.
maria-ml: for short term can we pin our nightly-eval to runtime@7f2e1b2 so evals are stable while we fix? That will avoid noisy alerts.
tonny-sre: (typo) tony-sre: I can pin the nightly eval jobs to that image tag for today. Deploy-bot, can you roll the nightly-eval runner?
deploy-bot: scheduled: pinned nightly-eval to runtime@7f2e1b2 for the next 24h per request by tony-sre.

kevin-runtime: plan: 1) reproduce minimal repro and write unit test that fails under new ordering 2) add PREFETCH_STRICT_ORDER guarded by env (no perf impact in default) 3) iterate on patch to maintain throughput but keep deterministic RNG behavior 4) if patch takes > 24h we'll revert PR #4821. I'm assigning myself.
sophia-qa: can you add a quick CI job that runs a small subset of grok_prompt_set with both builds and fails on >5% pass-drop? that'll catch regressions on PRs touching prefetch/KV.\e maria-ml: +1 on adding a small canary eval. We should also add a coverage test exercising sampling with quantized models since q kernels are more sensitive.
kevin-runtime: opening issue/patch now: https://git.redwood/pr/4875 - includes repro and a env-guard flag.

kevin-runtime: preliminary patch restores ordering around RNG calls while keeping prefetching overlapped for long-lived KV loads. Local perf microbench shows 3% throughput loss on synthetic microbench (acceptable vs rollback).
maria-ml: thanks. Once CI passes let's run a targeted nightly with the patched runtime and confirm grok_prompt_set pass-rate returns to baseline. Sophia can you schedule?
sophia-qa: scheduled a quick run on the patched build, will post results here when done.

sophia-qa: patched run result: grok_prompt_set pass=93.7% (close to baseline), repeat-rate back to normal.
maria-ml: awesome, looks like regression fixed. kevin please proceed with merge + add canary eval.
kevin-runtime: will merge PR #4875 after a short review, add canary job. I'll also add notes to the rollout checklist: any prefetch reorder must include sampling deterministic smoke tests.

maria-ml: thanks team. I'll file a postmortem summary for the eval-alert and include the mitigation timeline.
tonny-sre: (typo) tony-sre: closing loop: nightly-eval pinned image released back to main-nightly after patch deploy.
deploy-bot: deployed runtime@9a3b4c7-patch (PR #4875) to main-nightly.
maria-ml: :thumbsup:
